newsitem.title: UK: BP stops operations at Tirana airport due to unrest.
newsitem.headline: BP stops operations at Tirana airport due to unrest.

text.p: British Petroleum has stopped operations at Rinas airport in Tirana, Albania because of unrest in the area, the company said on Thursday.
BP is the sole supplier of jet fuel to the airport in a joint venture with the Albania state oil company, Petrolimpeks.

"It has been reported that the airport has been closed. In view of the unrest we have instructed our staff to go to minimum manning and close down operations until the the airport re-opens," said a company spokesman.
BP emplopyes eight staff at the airport all of who are Albanian nationals.
"Our prime concern is for the safety of our staff," he said.
Austrian Airlines said earlier on Thursday it had cancelled flights to Tirana until further notice.
